documentation.title: Docblock Examples
documentation.standard:
Every command docblock needs an ## EXAMPLES section with at least one realistic invocation; "wp help" shows it to users. An ## EXAMPLES heading in the longdesc passed to WP_CLI::add_command() counts as well.
Requirement: G2 (MUST, error). Error codes: MissingExamplesSection. Properties: ignoreMethods (method names that are never commands), ignoreClasses (classes that are never command classes).

code_comparison.code: /** * Reindex posts. * * ## EXAMPLES * * wp acme reindex --batch-size=200 */
